notes: As a standalone noun it is read ひと (hito). As a counter for people, use 一人 (ひとり, hitori) for one, 二人 (ふたり, futari) for two, and 〜人 (〜にん, -nin) for three or more.
Read 〜じん (-jin) as a suffix for nationality (e.g., 日本人, nihonjin, Japanese person).
